entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A blue-aligned necromancer and expert skaab stitcher from Innistrad who has a rivalry with his twin sister Gisa.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Geralf's twin sister, a ghoulcaller and necromancer.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane from which the Cecani twins come.

entities.name: Grimgrin
entities.description: A zombie created and mastered by Geralf, named in honor of his sister's face.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The former Lunarch of Thraben, killed by Geralf and brought back as a zombie by Liliana.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city from which the twins were banished and which Geralf besieged.

entities.name: The Moorland
entities.description: The area where the twins fought their undead war.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: A place Geralf took over before Gisa attacked it.

entities.name: NecroWarfare
entities.description: The undead war between Geralf and Gisa.

entities.name: The Five Laws of NecroWarfare
entities.description: Formal rules Geralf set for the contest, which Gisa defied.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Mikaeus back as a zombie and caused the sundering of the Helvault.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A champion of the church who captured Gisa.

entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: A construct whose sundering Liliana caused.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: An alchemist with whom Geralf lived and worked on his masterpiece, who later acts erratically.

entities.name: Wilhelt
entities.description: A suitor whose forces besieged Thraben and were repelled by Gisa.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Geralf with Ludevic to warn of the Phyrexian threat.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: The city in which Geralf lived by the time of the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Geralf and Gisa collaborated to rout the invaders on Innistrad.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane the twins reached through Omenpaths to join Oko's crew.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Leader of the crew that Geralf joined as medic.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: An Outcaster extracted from a guarded train by Oko's crew.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A crew member injured when zombies swept through the train.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Benefactor of the heist, who provided a telepathic link and was in truth Jace Beleren under an illusion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who posed as Ashiok and left without paying the gang.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: An Atiin nomad who helped the twins disable the zombie abomination.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The vault location for which a map was hidden in Thief's Folly.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The city where the vault was located.

events.summary: The twins are banished from Thraben and wage undead war against each other in the Moorland.
events.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and then moved to the Moorland

events.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it, starting NecroWarfare.
events.quote: Geralf took over Trostad, most likely massacring the inhabitants who didn't flee.

events.summary: Geralf sets up the siege of Thraben, sneaks in to kill Mikaeus, and meets Liliana who brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
events.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

events.summary: Odric captures Gisa and Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
events.quote: Shortly thereafter, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

events.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, then busies himself with his masterpiece under Ludevic.
events.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa briefly set aside their differences to join Liliana against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to join her and team up against the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Geralf tells Gisa by letter he wants nothing to do with her, then is horrified when she declares she will move in with him.
events.quote: Geralf wrote to his sister that he wanted nothing to do with her

events.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's laboratory in Havengul, and he forces her out; Ludevic and Sorin Markov warn him of the Phyrexian threat.
events.quote: They warned him about the impending Phyrexian threat.

events.summary: The siblings collaborate to rout the Phyrexian invaders but resume feuding afterward.
events.quote: The siblings collaborated to rout the invaders but returned to feuding as soon as they were gone.

events.summary: Geralf writes a paper on how magic weakens on foreign planes, then he and Gisa travel to Thunder Junction and join Oko's crew with Geralf as medic.
events.quote: Geralf and his sister traveled through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction and joined Oko 's crew, in which Geralf served as the team's medic.

events.summary: Gisa raises the zombies too early during the train mission after the twins bicker, but Nolan is extracted.
events.quote: Provoked by Geralf and distracted, Gisa raised the zombies too early while the train was moving.

events.summary: The twins secure the map to Maag Taranau at Thief's Folly with Stella Lee's help.
events.quote: they managed to disable the necromancy animating it and secure the map

events.summary: Ashiok is revealed as Jace Beleren under an illusion, who leaves without paying the gang.
events.quote: they revealed themself to be Jace Beleren under an illusion and planeswalked away without paying the gang.

relations.quote: He has a rivalry with his twin sister Gisa Cecani .

relations.note: Creator and master of the zombie.
relations.quote: Geralf is the creator and master of the zombie Grimgrin
Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

relations.note: Lives and works under the alchemist.
relations.quote: under the wing of the alchemist Ludevic

relations.note: Joined Oko's crew as its medic.
relations.quote: joined Oko 's crew, in which Geralf served as the team's medic
Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.
